title: Congress sends Borland to AARO at the end of March

tellings.quote: So they got me touching Arrow and I went to Arrow. Uh that was the end of March

plain: At the end of March 2023, members of Congress sent a man named Dylan Borland to speak with AARO, the Pentagon office set up to look into unexplained sightings in the sky. Borland, who says he went himself, tells Michels, "they got me touching Arrow and I went to Arrow," using a spoken form of the office's name.
